verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no shared team vaults, collections, or per-member access control. 2FAS Pass is anonymous and local-first, with personal cloud sync. 2FAS Share only sends one-off encrypted links with expiry and password options, and Security Tiers govern how one user accesses items, not member permissions. These are adjacent features, not the team-sharing capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
